author: Tabapisngi

title: Like the Limitless Pill but in Music Form
body:
Bought the annual plan and so far so good!

I work in an industry that requires long hours of focused, creative deep work. And Brain.fm has worked wonders for my productivity! 

I was just a trial user before and I already liked it, but when I saw a person in the industry that I looked up to blogging about how she uses Brain.fm to help her get work done, I went ahead and bought the app.

So far, I’m satisfied! It didn’t just help me concentrate on my work and get things done better, faster... It also helped me to wind down and recharge when I need to.

There are various timers you can set from 15 minutes to infinity.

Only problem: it lags a lot and keep buffering at times. Hope they take a leaf out of Spotify’s book about how to manage issues like this.

But overall, I’m still loving it!

Thanks, Brain.fm

title: Always buffering
body: I'm beginning to think if my oneyear subscription is worth it. I subscribed because a video i saw said that ai made the song continues. It's not true. In has time limits for every category. Focus for example has 2 hours. Relax has 30 mins. And so on. Then you have to select another time again. But I can't even get to the 2 hours of focus because the app keeps buffering. This doesn't happen to my spotify.
